prompt: Design two interlocked chain links in OpenSCAD for print-in-place, so they are linked but nowhere touching. Each link is a torus of 10 mm major radius and 2.5 mm minor radius, made with rotate_extrude at $fn = 64 over a circle at $fn = 32. Put the first link flat in the XY plane centred on the origin. Put the second link in the XZ plane, centred at X = 10, so it threads through the hole of the first. Put them in modules named link_a() and link_b() and call both at the top level.
